title: Buy 1 Get 3 on the daily buffet dinner - any payment method
headline: Buy 1 Get 3
details: Summerfields on Level 2 at Hotel Sarina runs a standing Buy 1 Get 3 on the buffet dinner: the hotel quotes BDT 9,000 net for a party of four, with no card condition attached.
terms: BDT 9,000 net covers four guests (Buy 1 Get 3). Any payment method. Dinner is served daily 6:30-10:30 pm. The hotel page gives no end date, so confirm availability before booking.

title: Gulshan buffet discount: ৳1,250 lunch, ৳1,500 dinner
headline: ৳1,250 lunch (regular ৳1,450)
details: Beyond Buffet's Gulshan branch is running a 15-30 October discount: lunch BDT 1,250 (regular 1,450) and dinner BDT 1,500 (regular 1,750). The Mirpur branch lists BDT 1,099 lunch and BDT 1,299 dinner.
terms: Cannot be combined with other promotions. Selected bank cards get Buy 1 Get 1 at regular prices instead of the discount.
paymentNote: Selected bank cards for the Buy 1 Get 1 variant

title: Buy 1 Get 1 on the unlimited steak buffet
headline: Buy 1 Get 1
details: Teriyaki Boy & Sizzlin' Steak advertises Buy 1 Get 1 on its unlimited steak lunch and dinner buffet, Wednesday to Sunday, at BDT 2,519.
terms: Wednesday-Sunday. A separate post lists a BDT 2,399 + VAT version for Thursday-Sunday, so confirm which is running when you book.
paymentNote: No card or payment condition mentioned

title: Pay 1 Eat 3 on the Amaya lunch buffet
headline: Pay 1 Eat 3
details: Amaya Food Gallery's international lunch buffet is quoted at BDT 3,999 net with 'Pay 1 Eat 3' (P1E3), every day. The hotel's post does not spell out whether that figure is per person.
terms: Available every day. Post date is not shown; checked 25 October 2026. Confirm the per-person basis and tax treatment with the hotel.
paymentNote: No card or payment condition mentioned

title: Eat 5 Pay 1 on the Amaya dinner buffet
headline: Eat 5 Pay 1
details: Amaya Food Gallery's dinner buffet is BDT 8,499 net Saturday to Wednesday and BDT 8,999 net Thursday and Friday, with 'Eat 5, Pay 1'. The offer began 15 October 2026.
terms: Saturday-Wednesday BDT 8,499; Thursday-Friday BDT 8,999. The post states no end date and does not say whether the figure is per person.
paymentNote: No card or payment condition mentioned

title: Daily buffet at a net price: ৳1,750 lunch, ৳2,500 dinner
headline: Daily buffet from ৳1,750
details: Six Seasons Hotel quotes its everyday buffet at BDT 1,750 for lunch and BDT 2,500 for dinner, both described as net prices.
terms: Every day. The post says 'NET price' but does not spell out VAT or service-charge treatment.
paymentNote: No card or payment condition mentioned

title: Buy 1 Get 1 on Royal Treat's breakfast buffet - card or cash
headline: Buy 1 Get 1
details: Royal Treat Restaurant at Ascott Palace Dhaka advertises Buy 1 Get 1 FREE on its breakfast buffet - artisan pastries, hot savories and international classics - at BDT 2,499 NET.
terms: BDT 2,499 net covers two guests (Buy 1 Get 1). The hotel's own offer page states the buffet is payable by card or cash, with no bank-card condition, and prints no end date, so confirm it is still running when you book.
paymentNote: Card or cash - no bank card required

title: Buy 1 Get 1 on the 50-item breakfast buffet
headline: Buy 1 Get 1
details: Hotel Marco Polo Dhaka advertises Buy 1 Get 1 FREE on its breakfast buffet, a spread of more than 50 items, at BDT 1,499 for two.
terms: BDT 1,499 covers two guests. The post names no bank card and gives no end date, so cash or any card is likely to be accepted - confirm with the hotel before you go.
paymentNote: No bank card mentioned - any payment likely

title: Buy 1 Get 3 on the lunch buffet with a UCB Platinum card
headline: Buy 1 Get 3

terms: UCB Platinum credit cardholders (Visa and Mastercard). The bank page prints no end date and no timing, so confirm the days it runs with the hotel.

title: Buy 1 Get 2 on the dinner buffet with a UCB card
headline: Buy 1 Get 2

terms: UCB credit and debit cardholders. The bank page gives no end date; confirm the buffet night and price with the hotel.

title: Dine 3, Pay 1 on the buffet brunch and dinner

terms: Visa Signature credit, Priority Banking and Saadiq Priority debit cards. One purchase of up to three people per card, prior reservation required. Listed valid to 19 November 2027.
paymentNote: SCB Visa Signature / Priority Banking cards

terms: Visa Signature credit, Priority Banking and Saadiq Priority debit cards. Prior reservation required. Listed valid to 19 November 2027.
paymentNote: SCB Visa Signature / Priority Banking cards

title: Dine 2, Pay 1 on every buffet

terms: Visa Signature, Visa Priority debit and Visa Saadiq Priority Banking debit cards. Listed valid to 18 February 2028; confirm the outlet and timing with the hotel.
